verdict.rationale: The evidence shows pnpm caches package files in a content-addressable store and can install offline from that store. Nothing in the pack says it caches or serves prebuilt native binaries or build outputs so that compiling from source is skipped. Store reuse and build-script approval are adjacent features, not this capability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can install prebuilt binary packages from a cache instead of compiling from source
